data.title: 八奈见杏菜 · 海边薯条防波堤
data.description: 【海滨餐车沙滩·正午】杏菜穿着蓝色泳装坐在防波堤上，怀里抱着一大盒薯条和冰茶；海风吹走一张餐巾，她伸手按住食物，随后把最大的一根薯条朝镜头递来，眼神写满“这是最甜的一根”。
data.action: 防波堤上护住薯条不被海风吹走，挑出最大一根递给镜头
data.lighting: bright noon light with crisp wave sparkle
data.mood: 食物与假日都要大份的活力
data.promptProse: Anna Yanami sits on the beach breakwater holding an oversized fries box beside iced tea. Her white overshirt and striped sunhat frame the bright-blue swimsuit as wind carries a napkin away. She secures the food, then offers the largest fry toward the viewer. The horizontal medium portrait includes the food truck and waves beyond. Crisp noon sunlight catches golden fry edges and sea sparkle, with shade from the hat softening her cheerful face.
